events.verdict: Labissiere (WAS) legally contests LaVine's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Raynaud (SAC) and Riley (WAS) briefly engage and disengage during rebounding.
Raynaud (SAC) briefly  grasps, and immediately releases, Riley's (WAS) jersey off-ball.
Riley (WAS) initiates lower body contact with Raynaud (SAC) as he falls to the floor, and the contact affects his SQBR.
LaVine (SAC) immediately removes his hands from Labissiere's (WAS) body as they separate following the pick.
Labissiere (WAS) briefly grasps, and quickly releases, LaVine's (SAC) arm as he elevates to receive the pass.
Riley (WAS) legally contests LaVine's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Stevens (SAC) initiates contact with Cooper's (WAS) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Cooper (WAS) and DeRozan (SAC) come together at the same spot and incidental foot to foot contact occurs at the start of the drive.
Raynaud (SAC) initiates contact with Cooper (WAS) that affects his SQBR.
Stevens (SAC) initiates contact with Cooper's (WAS) right arm, and the contact causes him to lose control of the ball.
Cooper (WAS) falls to the floor as LaVine (SAC) secures possession, and the lower body contact is marginal
Riley (WAS) directly contests LaVine's (SAC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to LaVine's hand after the release.
Clifford (SAC) commits a take foul on Cooper (WAS).
